description: Move outbox drafts into the repo memory dir for review. Before copying, reports graph lint (never blocking) and auto-applies the deterministic tier: exact-duplicate merges, empty-body archives, first-line title normalization, and high-confidence type/tag inference from keyword captures. Every applied action appears in the output with its undo command; pass noCurate=true to skip curation (lint still reports). D95: semantic merges, splits and uncertain type/tag inferences are one batch-confirm summary — when they exist, submit stops before writing anything and returns the summary. Show that summary to the user, then call again with either curateBatch="accept" (apply the whole batch) or curateBatch="decline" (change nothing). Never per-item approval, never silently apply the batch. Then copies the drafts in as proposed (or keeps a local approval), commits locally on the current branch, and moves the outbox originals out. Never creates a branch on its own — pass branch= only with the user's explicit approval for the full chain. Prints the push and PR commands — those need the user's explicit approval and are never run automatically. (MCP server and the `open-memex submit` CLI; the opencode native plugin does not expose this tool.) Unknown ids or a failed local commit abort the submit with the reason; nothing is published automatically.

base.description: PR base branch override. Default: the branch the submit ran on.

branch.description: Create this branch and submit onto it. If omitted, submit stays on the current branch — branches are never auto-created. Only pass this when the user explicitly approved the full chain (branch + push + PR).

curateBatch.description: D95: the ONE decision for the batch-confirm tier (semantic merges, splits, uncertain type/tag inferences). When proposals exist and this is omitted, submit writes nothing and returns the summary — show it to the user, then call again with accept or decline. Never per-item approval.

noCurate.description: Skip curation entirely (auto and batch); the graph lint report still runs. Default false.

name: memory_submit
